description: Find the existing software products that already do what an idea, a product name or a website does — the same search as risetive.com/find. Use this first when the user asks who else does something, what the alternatives are, or whether something already exists. Returns a one-sentence answer (how many products do it and how big the biggest is), what the input was understood as, and the products doing it, each with its one-line description, monthly visits, Paid/Free when known, whether its site is new, and its niche, most visited first, 25 at a time (page.nextOffset asks for the next ones); products with 10M+ monthly visits come apart in giants. Also the niche most of them are in. For a website it also says whether Risetive lists it. When nothing does the idea yet, the nearest products are returned separately. For one product's features and pricing, call risetive_get_product_profile with its domain. A search takes about 10–60 seconds. Without an account: 5 searches a day and 10 competitors per search. A free Risetive account: 6 searches a day, shared with the website, and every competitor. Risetive Pro ($19/year): unlimited searches. When a list is cut, the answer says how many more there are.

idea.description: A product idea in one sentence ("an app that turns meeting notes into tasks"), a product name ("Notion") or a website ("notion.so" or "https://notion.so"). Up to 300 characters.

limit.description: How many competitors to return, 1–50; 25 when omitted.

offset.description: How many of the most visited competitors to skip; pass page.nextOffset from the last answer for the next ones. The same idea on the same day is not searched again.

name: risetive_find_competitors
title: See who is already building an idea or product

description: Read one listed software product by its domain: what it does, its main features, monthly visits, backlinks, referring domains, pricing (paid/free/gated, starting price, model) and its niche with its rank there. Use it after risetive_find_competitors or risetive_list_niche_players to look at one product in depth; it does not search — pass an exact domain. Returns not-found for domains Risetive does not list. Works without signing in (small daily allowance, at most 5 rows per list); a free Risetive account returns full results.

domain.description: The product's domain or homepage URL, e.g. "canva.com".

name: risetive_get_product_profile
title: Get a product profile

description: List up to ten products most recently added to Risetive in one niche, newest first, with the same fields as risetive_list_niche_players and when each was added. Use it to see who just entered a niche; the added date is when Risetive listed the product, not its launch date. Works without signing in (small daily allowance, at most 5 rows per list); a free Risetive account returns full results.

niche.description: Niche slug as returned by risetive_find_competitors or risetive_get_product_profile, or in a niche URL, e.g. "ai-photo-and-image-editors".

name: risetive_list_new_entrants
title: List the newest products in a niche

description: List up to eight leading products in one niche — current top products first, then by monthly visits — each with its one-line description, monthly visits, referring domains and pricing. Use it to see who leads a niche; use risetive_list_new_entrants for the newest products in it. No pagination. Works without signing in (small daily allowance, at most 5 rows per list); a free Risetive account returns full results.

niche.description: Niche slug as returned by risetive_find_competitors or risetive_get_product_profile, or in a niche URL, e.g. "ai-photo-and-image-editors".

name: risetive_list_niche_players
title: List the leading products in a niche

description: List the niches and products the signed-in user saved, with each item's id (pass it as savedItemId to risetive_remove_saved_item). Only the user's own items. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.
name: risetive_list_saved_items
title: List saved Risetive items

description: Remove one item from the signed-in user's Saved list by the id that risetive_save_item or risetive_list_saved_items returns; the niche, product or project itself is not affected. Removing an item that is already gone returns removed: false. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.
name: risetive_remove_saved_item
title: Remove a saved Risetive item

description: Save a niche or a product to the signed-in user's Risetive Saved list (risetive.com/saved). Pass kind and key: kind "market" with a niche slug as key, or kind "product" with a product id (from risetive_get_product_profile, risetive_list_niche_players or risetive_list_new_entrants) as key. Returns the saved item's id; saving an item twice keeps one copy. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.
name: risetive_save_item
title: Save a Risetive item
